questions.label: Why these questions
value: **Why these questions are together.** One answer here can end this step: the rule ends this pathway ("Prescription handover requested") and hands the patient over to the NCD advanced care service (stop row `refer_for_individual_plan`). So these questions come first.
**Heading** "Prescribe or refer": agent's choice, review pending. B1, A2: the decision comes before the details. "Refer" alone ends this step (stop row refer_for_individual_plan).
